svg.aria-label: High-level AgentCore PoC architecture: humans sign into AI chat app, AgentCore Runtime and Gateway invoke four downstream systems: shared RAG with IAM, Network Operations API with Entra OBO and machine OAuth, external vendor with separate OAuth, Platform Health API with SigV4 IAM. Automated reporter enters through IAM.
svg.text: AWS AgentCore — four downstream systems, different security requirements
One AI application; each connected system decides which identity and permissions it accepts.
Auth: AWS IAM service role • shared documents
Four endpoints • same backend for people and Reporter
Auth: Entra OAuth • human OBO or app-only token
Network API checks users, roles and database access
Auth: its own vendor OAuth (Cognito simulation)
Auth: IAM/SigV4 • Cedar checks user before call
Solid arrows: human tools via G1. Dashed purple: scheduled Reporter via G2.
Each final REST API authenticates the caller it receives; RDS is accessed only by the Network API's Lambda.
